description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode, +500 ATK & +500 MAG to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth Ability Boost, Triplecast Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth, Unlimited Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth Abilities, Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth Abilities; Ends after using 8 Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth abilities
TP Max: AOE Fire/NE, Ice/NE, Wind/NE or Earth/NE hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1 under En-Fire, En-Ice, En-Wind or En-Earth

description.name: War-Awoken Sketch Mimicry Dragonking (Weapon Skill)
description.text:
Single-target Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth/NE piercing hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if there are 0-1/2+ members with Attach Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth allies
WS Blue: Dualcast Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth 3, Instant Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth 3 & Weakness Damage +30% for 3 turns
WS Gold: During Tactical Awoken Mode, chases ally's Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth ability with Mimic 2 to user (max 4 chases)
